defects.missing_cta: There is no button or link to sign up, buy or start.
defects.hidden_price: The page never says what the paid product or plans cost.
defects.contradiction: Two parts of the page make claims that cannot both be true.
defects.vague_headline: The main headline does not say what the product is or does.
defects.typos: Misspelled words in prominent text such as the headline.
defects.placeholder_text: Leftover template text such as 'Lorem ipsum' or '{{name}}' is visible.
defects.low_contrast: Important text is very hard to read against its background.
defects.broken_image: An image failed to load and shows an empty box or broken-image icon.
defects.blocking_popup: A popup or overlay covers the main content when the page opens.
defects.cut_off_text: Text is cut off or hidden by another element, so it cannot be fully read.
